driver: tokenomics.train.producer_improve (producer-only PPO, frozen proportional orderer, BC anchor) + tokenomics.eval.producer_rungs (quantity-rung gate) + tokenomics.eval.swap_eval (2x2 swap baseline)
question: Can the Phase-2 producer clone (EXP-0002 d3_perm) survive the quantity rungs and then improve BEYOND stock_aware via producer-only RL, while the orderer stays fixed to proportional? smoke_ppo --init-from is excluded because it co-trains the orderer, confounding the standalone-producer question.

models.M0: control: EXP-0002 d3_perm clone, no training — the current bar
models.M2: producer-only improvement v1: init from d3_perm, train producer actor only, orderer frozen to proportional, conservative PPO (low lr + tight target-KL) with BC anchor to the clone

acceptance: Accept improved producer only if: death <= 0.05 everywhere; d3_p00 ratio >= d3_perm - 0.02; held-out seed/perm ratio >= 0.80; L1 trace healthy; beats base+base by >= 5% on at least one meaningful rung/topology OR matches units while materially reducing rejects/waste. Reject if improvement appears only on seed 0, if L1 decay returns, or if held-out ratios drop.

artifacts.prod_improve_v1.pt: M2 best-selected producer-only checkpoint (orderer = unchanged clone orderer, present only for schema; eval pairs it with proportional)
artifacts.m2_prod_improve_v1_rungs.csv: M2 improved-checkpoint quantity-rung table (same grid as M0, for the per-cell clone->improved comparison)
artifacts.prod_improve_v1_curve.csv: M2 per-iter training curve (canonical = CPU-pod run)
artifacts.prod_improve_v1_local.pt / prod_improve_: M2 backup from the local rerun (torch 2.12.0 vs pod 2.12.1; same conclusion, held-out-min differs)

compute.where: M0 + rung/trace evals: local CPU (BLAS 1 thread). M2 v1 training: CPU Runpod pod kgmtmt2lqxyz4s (8 vCPU, 32GB, runpod/base ubuntu2004, python3.12, torch 2.12.1+cpu) via run_pod_training.py --cpu --python python3.12
compute.wall_time: M0 rungs ~2 min; M2 v1 ~20 min on the CPU pod (~6 s/iter)

cpu_pod_notes: run_pod_training.py gained a --cpu profile + --python flag for base CPU images: isolated venv built from python3.12 (base image python3 is 3.8 < requires-python 3.11), torch installed from the CPU wheel index (download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu) so the CUDA build's multi-GB nvidia-* deps don't overflow the 5GB container disk, --no-cache-dir to spare disk. (An earlier GPU pod with a 512MB memory cgroup thrashed torch and was abandoned.)
